text: Isa.10.12. , Or, the pride of Iacob and the pride of Israel.
Or, died scarlet. , Heb. fierie torches.
Or, gallants , Hebr. couering or couerer.
Or, That which was established, or, there was a stand made. , Or, discouered.
Or, from the dayes that she hath bene. , Or, cause them to turn.
Or, And their infinite store, &c. , Heb. vessels of desire..
